My research interests lie in statistics and phylogenetics.
My publications are listed on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=bZ3L-mkAAAAJ&sortby=pubdate), and code for my research projects is available on [GitHub](https://github.com/lukejkelly).
My contact details are [here](https://www.ucc.ie/en/matsci/people/lukekelly/).

I have been a Lecturer (Above the Bar) at UCC since 2022.
Previously, I was a postdoc in CEREMADE (2020--2022) at Université Paris Dauphine-PSL.
Before that, I was a senior postdoc at the Big Data Institute (2019--2020), a stipendiary lecturer at St Peter's College (2019--2020) and a postdoc in the Department of Statistics (2016--2019), all at the University of Oxford.

I completed my DPhil in Statistics at the University of Oxford in 2016 supervised by Geoff Nicholls.
I received an MASt in Mathematics from the University of Cambridge in 2012 and a Bachelor of Actuarial & Financial Studies from University College Dublin in 2011.
